title: 宝塚記念の後に・終わる春

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Though she ran with all she had, Sakura Chiyono O's performance feels markedly different from before. The other racers are still full of energy even after the race, in stark contrast to her own state.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just then, Sakura Chiyono O feels an unsettling sensation, like she's starting to crumble. While other racers are preparing their futures, she's beginning to decay…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, Maruzensky continues to train. Even if she can't return to her peak, she finds strength in her desire to run with everything she's got in the present.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Japan Cup Sakura Chiyono O promised to run in with Maruzensky is fast approaching, and she decides to run in another G1 race to prepare for it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We set the autumn Tenno Sho as her next goal race. She also asks me to keep her condition a secret, promising that she'll be okay.
